title: Harborline Domain Credit on Certificate Auto-Renewals
content:
**Domain team credit note: Harborline domain credit on SSL/TLS Certificates auto-renewals**

An auto-renew charge on an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription whose covered domain is a Harborline registration under Domain Registrations, recorded in status active, carries the Harborline domain credit according to that registration's nameservers:

| Covered domain on the subscription | Harborline domain credit on the auto-renew charge |
|---|---|
| a Domain Registrations registration in status active, nameservers Harborline DNS (domain validation there completing automatically) | 6.00 USD |
| a Domain Registrations registration in status active, external nameservers | 3.00 USD |
| a registration not in status active, or a domain not registered with Harborline | no Harborline domain credit |

**Reading the records.** The covered domain is the Harborline domain holding linked to the certificate subscription. Its status and its nameserver setting are read from the Domain Registrations record of that holding. A certificate whose domain is registered with another registrar has no linked Harborline holding and carries no credit.

**Combinations**

| Registration status active | Nameservers | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Harborline DNS | 6.00 USD |
| yes | external | 3.00 USD |
| no | any | none |

**Hypothetical cases (for illustration only).** A subscription covering *ledger.example*, linked to a Harborline registration that is active on Harborline DNS, carries a 6.00 USD credit on its auto-renew charge. The same subscription, after the registration had been moved to external nameservers, would carry 3.00 USD. A subscription covering a domain held at another registrar carries no Harborline domain credit.
